title: Migrate: For HTTP/1 servers, when MaxBytesReader's limit is exceeded, "Connection: close" header is… (CVE-2026-97054)
description: CVE-2026-97054 is a vulnerability in the migrate package affecting HTTP/1 servers. When the MaxBytesReader's limit is exceeded, the server automatically sets the "Connection: close" header without synchronization. This can cause a race condition if another header is set explicitly in the server handler. The issue affects versions prior to 4.19.1-r6 and 1.27.3-r4 and has been assigned a medium severity rating.
